infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: EjeepHero needs your location to track your ride and show your position on the map.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: EjeepHero needs your location to provide accurate ETAs and proximity alerts even when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: EjeepHero needs accelerometer access to detect potential anomalies or crashes.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow EjeepHero to use your location.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow EjeepHero to access your contacts to set emergency speed dials.
